summary: Describes an approach to carrying out large-scale SNMP traffic measurements to learn how SNMP is used in practice, since typical usage patterns are unclear. It also covers exchange formats for traces of that traffic so researchers can share data. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Everyone uses SNMP, but few know how. This describes how to watch lots of network chatter, record it in a shared format, and learn from the results.

questions: how is snmp used in practice
